name: Yoshinaga Nozomi
source:
A "yamato nadeshiko" type of girl. She used to be a street performer, but now is a highly sought-after idol. Her fans lovingly call her "Non-chan". It seems that [url=/c85109]Sayashi[/url] is somehow involved in her drastic "transformation"…

[Based on the [url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/uuultrac/blank-19]official description[/url]]

[Spoiler]She’s actually 28 years old, but her agency made her say she's 20.[/spoiler]
